svg.title: Among the countries shown, the scenario gap relative to the medium scenario is largest in China and smallest in the United States
svg.desc: Column chart: Among the countries shown, the scenario gap relative to the medium scenario is largest in China and smallest in the United States: Gap / medium: China: 86.6%, South Korea: 84.5%, Türkiye: 81.2%, India: 80.1%, World: 72.8%, Nigeria: 68.1%, France: 64.8%, United States: 61.5%.
